description: This file implements a simulated network service for a modem, including handling of network registration, signal strength, operator selection, and various AT command responses within a modem simulator environment.

classes.name: NetworkService
classes.description: A class that simulates network service behavior in a modem environment, handling commands, registration states, signal strength, and operator management.

classes.name: NetworkService::KeepSignalStrengthChangingLoop
classes.description: A helper class that periodically modifies the signal strength to simulate dynamic signal conditions.

methods.name: NetworkService::InitializeCommandHandlers
methods.description: Initializes the list of command handlers for AT commands related to network operations.

methods.name: NetworkService::InitializeServiceState
methods.description: Sets the initial state of the network service, including radio state, capabilities, and operator list.

methods.name: NetworkService::InitializeNetworkOperator
methods.description: Initializes the list of available network operators and sets the current operator based on the selection mode.

methods.name: NetworkService::InitializeSimOperator
methods.description: Sets the simulated operator based on the current SIM operator, possibly loading from an XML configuration.

methods.name: NetworkService::SetupDependency
methods.description: Sets dependencies on other services such as misc, sim, and data services.

methods.name: NetworkService::OnSimStatusChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in SIM status, updating registration state accordingly.

methods.name: NetworkService::HandleRadioPowerReq
methods.description: Handles AT command +CFUN? to report current radio power state.

methods.name: NetworkService::HandleRadioPower
methods.description: Handles AT command +CFUN= to set the radio power state.

methods.name: NetworkService::WakeupFromSleep
methods.description: Heuristic to determine if the device should wake up from sleep based on signal request timing.

methods.name: NetworkService::HandleSignalStrength
methods.description: Handles AT command +CSQ to report current signal strength metrics.

methods.name: NetworkService::IsHasNetwork
methods.description: Checks if the network is currently active based on radio state and operator selection mode.

methods.name: NetworkService::HandleVoiceNetworkRegistration
methods.description: Handles AT commands +CREG? to report voice registration status.

methods.name: NetworkService::HandleDataNetworkRegistration
methods.description: Handles AT commands +CGREG? and +CEREG? to report data registration status.

methods.name: NetworkService::HandleGetPreferredNetworkType
methods.description: Handles AT command ++CTEC? to report current network mode and preferences.

methods.name: NetworkService::HandleQuerySupportedTechs
methods.description: Handles AT command ++CTEC=? to list supported technologies.

methods.name: NetworkService::HandleSetPreferredNetworkType
methods.description: Handles AT command ++CTEC= to set preferred network modes and update registration accordingly.

methods.name: NetworkService::UpdateRegisterState
methods.description: Updates registration state and notifies other components.

methods.name: NetworkService::BuildCSQCommandResponse
methods.description: Constructs the response string for +CSQ signal strength command.

methods.name: NetworkService::GetCurrentSignalStrength
methods.description: Generates current simulated signal strength metrics based on network mode.

methods.name: NetworkService::HandleReceiveRemoteVoiceDataReg
methods.description: Handles remote command to change registration state.

methods.name: NetworkService::HandleReceiveRemoteCTEC
methods.description: Handles remote command to change network mode (CTEC).

methods.name: NetworkService::HandleReceiveRemoteSignal
methods.description: Handles remote command to update signal strength percentage.

methods.name: NetworkService::HandleIdentifierDisclosure
methods.description: Handles unsolicited disclosure events.

methods.name: NetworkService::HandleSecurityAlgorithmUpdate
methods.description: Handles unsolicited security algorithm update events.

methods.name: NetworkService::OnSignalStrengthChanged
methods.description: Triggers sending of updated signal strength unsolicited response.

methods.name: NetworkService::KeepSignalStrengthChangingLoop::Start
methods.description: Starts the loop that periodically modifies signal strength.

methods.name: NetworkService::KeepSignalStrengthChangingLoop::UpdateSignalStrengthCallback
methods.description: Callback that adjusts signal strength periodically to simulate changing conditions.
